topPRs.title: feat: add betanet task for revshare
topPRs.author: 0xChin
topPRs.body:
Summary                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  - Adds task 060-betanet-rev-share to upgrade and enable Revenue Share on the Betanet L2 chain (revshare-beta-0, chainId: 420120033)                                                                                 
  - The task deploys RevShare contract implementations and upgrades fee vault proxies to enable automated revenue sharing                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  Details                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  This task enables the Revenue Share feature on Betanet by:                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  1. Deploying contract implementations:                                                                                                                                                                              
    - FeeVaults (Sequencer, Base, L1, Operator)                                                                                                                                                                       
    - FeeSplitter                                                                                                                                                                                                     
    - L1Withdrawer (pointing to FeesDepositor on L1: 0xed9B99a703BaD32AC96FDdc313c0652e379251Fd)                                                                                                                      
    - SuperchainRevenueShareCalculator (pointing to L1Withdrawer and ChainFeesRecipient)                                                                                                                              
  2. Upgrading fee vault proxies:                                                                                                                                                                                     
    - SequencerFeeVault, BaseFeeVault, L1FeeVault, OperatorFeeVault                                                                                                                                                   
  3. Configuring revenue sharing:                                                                                                                                                                                     
    - Sets FeeSplitter predeploy to use the new implementation                                                                                                                                                        
    - Initializes with RevShareCalculator address                                                                                                                                                                     
    - Min withdrawal amount: 2 ETH                                                                                                                                                                                    
    - Withdrawal gas limit: 800,000                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  Acceptance Tests                                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  The acceptance tests for this task are the post-task assertions in test/integration/RevSharePostTaskAssertions.t.sol. These tests should be run after task execution to validate the upgrade was successful:        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  - test_assertRevShareState() - Validates L2 RevShare contract state (FeeSplitter configuration, L1Withdrawer settings, calculator addresses)                                                                        
  - test_withdrawalFlow() - End-to-end test of the withdrawal mechanism:                                                                                                                                              
    - Part 1: Funds vaults below threshold, verifies no withdrawal triggers                                                                                                                                           
    - Part 2: Funds vaults above threshold, verifies withdrawal initiates and funds route through L1 to OP L2
